# Jonas Poxleitner

> Personal site of Jonas Poxleitner, a full-stack software developer building open-source software.

Jonas builds Flutter apps for iOS and Android, static web tools and Java services. This site lists the projects, links and contact details.

## Projects

- [Minimalistic Push](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/minimalistic-push/id1528998913): Flutter app that tracks push-up sessions, with a background that follows the latest performance.
- [PEEKBAR](https://github.com/orgs/peekbar): Organization where free and open-source software for businesses is developed.
- [Rowing Workouts](https://rowing.vlkn.io): Flutter app that walks through bundled rowing interval workouts while keeping the stroke rate.
- [Photo Collector](https://photo-collector.vlkn.io): Fully static, self-hosted app that lets event guests upload photos and videos straight to S3-compatible storage.
- [Cartographer](https://github.com/jonaspoxleitner/cartographer): Java 21 tool that merges GPX hiking routes into a route graph, rendering SVG maps and serving an interactive web map with pathfinding.
